description.value: La Stella Trattoria is a cozy Italian restaurant in Nanaimo focused on fresh, seasonal Vancouver Island ingredients prepared using old-world methods. It holds the distinction of importing Nanaimo's first wood-fired pizza oven, producing Neapolitan-style pies with a crisp, charred crust alongside hand-made pastas crafted from scratch daily. The kitchen also makes gluten-free pasta in-house using its own recipe, making it one of the more accommodating stops for cyclists with dietary needs.
